campaign.title: hermes-maintainer architecture
campaign.summary: Read-only coordination plane: ingest GitHub and git, normalize into SQLite, cluster campaigns, and select fix atoms. Nothing here writes back to NousResearch/hermes-agent.

nodes.title: GitHub API
nodes.summary: Issue and PR metadata. hermes-maintainer is pull-only; foreign ticket closes return 403.

nodes.title: git remote
nodes.summary: The hermes-agent remote. Ancestry, patch-id, and donor commits come from the mirror, not from GitHub HTML.

nodes.title: Evidence before closure
nodes.summary: duplicate_of, same_root_cause, partially_addresses, and verified_fixed_on stay distinct. An LLM confidence score is never an authorization signal.

nodes.title: Metadata ingest
nodes.summary: Fast scan of recently updated issues and PRs. Labels, state, and explicit references land here first.

nodes.title: Bare mirror
nodes.summary: Local git fetch. Patch hashes, stacked-on edges, and incorporate-commit checks read this tree.

nodes.title: Normalization layer
nodes.summary: Turns GitHub JSON and git objects into typed nodes: owner/name:issue:N, owner/name:pr:N, commit:sha, file:path.

nodes.title: SQLite backlog graph
nodes.summary: Source of truth for maintenance state. FTS5 for lexical retrieval. Ordinary tables, not a graph database, until measured complexity says otherwise.

nodes.title: graph/store.py
nodes.summary: Typed subgraph export, filters, and connected components used by the campaign canvas.

nodes.title: Explicit refs
nodes.summary: Fixes, duplicate_of, stacked_on, and other relations parsed from issue/PR prose — not inferred from title similarity alone.

nodes.title: Similarity engine
nodes.summary: Lexical (and optional embedding) candidates. These become possible_duplicate edges that still need a human or a probe.

nodes.title: git analysis
nodes.summary: Patch-id, overlapping hunks, incorporated commits. Distinguishes a donor atom from a whole competing PR.

nodes.title: Campaign graph
nodes.summary: A campaign is a problem family: canonical issue, survivor, donors, provenance, stacked children, superseded work.

nodes.title: CI verdict integrity
nodes.summary: Pilot family: a cancelled or unknown required check must not count as green. Reconcile existing patches; do not open another PR.

nodes.title: Fix atoms
nodes.summary: Smallest reviewable unit that can be selected. MVP is PR-level; the target model is commit- and hunk-aware.

nodes.title: Evidence engine
nodes.summary: Receipts from reported → source_confirmed → reproduced → verified_candidate → verified_integration → verified_main.

nodes.title: Merge-set optimizer
nodes.summary: Greedy coverage first. CP-SAT only after requires/conflicts are trustworthy. Maximize verified issue weight, not PR count.

nodes.title: Local API/UI
nodes.summary: This dashboard. Click a node for the issue, PR, campaign, file, or invariant it stands for. GitHub remains read-only.

nodes.title: Agent work packets
nodes.summary: Bounded tasks for cloud agents: reproduce, reconcile, challenge. Workers around the graph, never owners of repository truth.
